clinic.label: For your clinical team
clinic.title: A second set of eyes — never a replacement for yours
clinic.desc: Studies open in the Owner → Patient → Study flow you already use. AI quietly flags regions worth a closer look; the diagnosis stays with the clinician.

owner.label: For the families you treat
owner.title: So owners leave knowing what's going on
owner.desc: When the study makes sense, the worry softens. VetImage turns the image into a clear, plain-language picture your team can share right at the table.
owner.b2: Annotated images that point to what matters
owner.b3: A shareable record to take home

viewer.heading: The study, the patient, and the people who love them — one screen
viewer.desc: VetImage keeps the whole context together. The clinician reviews; the AI assists; the owner understands. No one is reduced to a file number.
viewer.f1Desc: The workflow your clinic actually uses, not a generic DICOM dump.
viewer.f2Desc: Suggested regions are flagged for review and always confirmed by a clinician.
viewer.f3Desc: Turn a complex study into something a worried family can understand.
